title: Protocol for DNA Extraction from Urine
author: A. Lenore Ackerman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wgsfbwe
materials: Enzyme buffer (0.5 M Tris, 1 mM EDTA, 0.2% 2-mercaptoethanol)
Bead beat on high for 1 minute
Bead beat on high for 1 minuteThermal Disruption

steps.title: Initial Urine Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 30 ml of urine for 15 minutes at 1500 X G at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Pour off supernatant into a separate 50 ml tube and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Enzymatic Disruption
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic disruption of the pellets in 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellets in 500 uL Enzyme buffer (0.5 M Tris, 1 mM EDTA, 0.2% 2-mercaptoethanol, pH 7.5)
Add 100 uL Lyticase (2000 U/ml) and 100 uL Lysozyme (100 mg/ml)
Incubate at 30°C for 30 minutes, inverting every 5-10 minutes
Centrifuge at 4000 rcf for 5 minutes
Remove supernatant

steps.title: Mechanical Disruption
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical disruption of the pellet using beads and heat.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 800 uL Stool DNA stabilizer
Add 100 uL 0.1 mm beads and 300 uL 0.5 mm beads
Spin briefly at 17,000 X G
Heat at 95°C for 5 minutes
Vortex for 5 seconds
Heat at 95°C for 5 minutes
Vortex for 5 seconds
Cool on ice for 5 minutes
Centrifuge at 17,000 X G for 1 minute

steps.title: DNA Lysis and Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for DNA extraction using proteinase K and Buffer AL.

substeps.instruction: Divide 350 ml of each sample into two 1.5 ml tubes
Add 10 ul proteinase K mixture (Qiagen #1017738) to each sample
Add 250 ul Buffer AL+Carrier [Poly (A) Sigma-Aldrich #10108626001 10ng/ml] to each sample
Vortex for 15 seconds
Incubate at 70°C for 10 minutes
Add 250 uL 100% EtOH to each sample
Mix by vortexing for 5 seconds

steps.title: DNA Purification via Spin Column
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using QIAamp Mini Spin Columns (#1011706).

substeps.instruction: Transfer mixture from the first tube to the spin column and centrifuge at 17,000 X G for 1 minute
Change collection tube, transfer mixture from the second tube to the spin column and centrifuge at 17,000 X G for 1 minute
Change collection tube and add 500 uL Buffer AW1 to the column
Centrifuge at 17,000 X G for 1 minute
Change collection tube and add 500 uL AW2 to the column
Centrifuge at 17,000 X G for 3 minutes
Remove residual EtOH by centrifuging an additional 1 min at max speed

steps.title: DNA Elution and Quantification
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA and measure its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Transfer column to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube
Add 50 uL Buffer AE to the column, incubate at RT for 5 minutes, and spin at 17,000 X G for 1 minute
Transfer fluid from collection tube back to spin column and repeat the elution step
Measure DNA concentration on Nanodrop 2000 Spectrophotometer
